text:
Our field sales team piloted an AI note-taker for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

Reps got back five hours a week. Post-visit admin dropped, and CRM updates happened the same day.

Accuracy depended on the setting. Quiet offices worked well. Noisy plant floors and car calls did not, so we added a voice recap habit.

Customers cared about consent. Asking upfront took ten seconds and built trust.

Managers gained the most. Coaching shifted from guesswork to real call examples.

The biggest lesson: the tool changed nothing until we redesigned the follow-up routine around it. New rule: every note becomes a next step within 24 hours, with an owner and a date.

Would your team use it in the field?
